description:
Work with your Sleekplan workspace — feedback board, roadmap, changelog, and surveys — directly from ChatGPT.

Ask for a summary of your top feature requests and see what customers are actually asking for, ranked by votes and recent activity. Find duplicate posts and merge them so votes count toward a single request. Update statuses, assign tags, and reply to customers with comments. When you ship something, draft and publish a changelog entry without leaving the conversation. Review NPS, CSAT, and survey responses to understand how users feel about your product.

The plugin covers 40+ actions across feedback posts, votes and voters, comments, tags, statuses, users and segments, surveys, and changelog entries. Reads run instantly; anything that changes data — creating, editing, merging, deleting — is shown to you and confirmed before it runs.

Requires a Sleekplan workspace with admin or contributor access. Sign in with your Sleekplan account when connecting.

defaultPrompt: create an NPS survey for our customers
turn my commit notes into a changelog draft
